influences.name: Errorsmith
influences.context: My first introduction was through Razor. And it's crazy because I recently met the guy who made it, Errorsmith... I was so excited to meet him in person because I love RAZOR.

influences.name: Holly Herndon
influences.context: Holly had heard my track 'Erotic Heat' and wrote to me saying how much she loved it. After that, we just kept talking, and it escalated into us collaborating on my track 'Expand'.

influences.name: Luther Vandross
influences.context: The first record that I can remember is Luther Vandross, 'Never Too Much,' at like three or four years old. I think Luther is my mother's favorite.

influences.name: Johnny Jackson
influences.context: Before he passed away, I was getting ready to take drum lessons from Johnny Jackson, Jo Jackson, who used to be in The Jackson 5, their drummer...I used to watch Johnny play every time I had a chance to, and I fell in love with the way he could stretch that drum set — that to me was just crazy.

influences.name: Rick Owens
influences.context: Another person I learned that from was [the designer] Rick Owens. He and William Basinski actually. They talked about having to create the buildup, that you don't have to come out swinging all the time, you know? I really learned that from Rick.

influences.name: William Basinski
influences.context: Another person I learned that from was [the designer] Rick Owens. He and William Basinski actually. They talked about having to create the buildup...And then when I wrote Autobiography...I was really learning it from William; I sent the first track, 'Spiritual Atom,' to Billy, to have him listen to it. He said, 'It sounds beautiful, but let it open up.'

influences.name: Jlin's mom
influences.context: I learned that from my mom. She said, if you are afraid to do it, that's exactly what you should be doing.

influences.name: Bruce Lee
influences.context: I got that from Bruce Lee, 'Be water, my friend.' Whatever you touch, you can adapt.

influences.name: Kuedo
influences.context: I remember Kuedo coming up to me after the show. He grabbed me and hugged me so hard and said, 'I am so proud of you.' He was so excited.

influences.name: Howard Shore
influences.context: All of Howard Shore is insane; the production is crazy. So, I love different soundtracks.

influences.name: A friend
influences.context: My main DAW is FL Studio—a friend introduced me to it when I was first starting out.
